statement_blocker: The repository gives a theorem-family name and the gloss 'the Davenport constant of finite abelian groups', not a proposition. It does not choose Olson's p-group equality D(G)=D*(G), the rank-at-most-two equality, the special value D((Z/nZ)^2)=2n-1, a direct forcing theorem, or an extremal zero-sum-free formulation. It also omits the definition of D(G), sequence/subsequence model, nonemptiness convention, additive versus multiplicative notation, group presentation and subclass, ordered binders, hypotheses, conclusion, and boundary cases. Selecting one candidate without accountable source approval would invent proposition-changing scope.
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix a finite additive abelian group or explicit finite invariant-factor decomposition; a prime and p-group predicate if applicable; the sequence carrier and finiteness model; universes; and all group, finite, decidability, decomposition, positivity, and divisibility data.
conclusion: Open: the catalog does not select a value/equality for the Davenport constant, an upper/lower bound pair, a least-length forcing theorem, a maximal zero-sum-free theorem, or one checked equivalence among these forms.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; statement work must resolve the trivial group, empty decomposition, rank one, threshold and nonemptiness cases, duplicate and zero terms, p=2, non-p-groups, rank-three groups, and every representation boundary listed in scope-map.md.
